# Sacha Duvivier — Freelance & Full Remote Fullstack Developer

> Sacha Duvivier (online handle: SachaDVR) is a fullstack developer based in Lille, France,
> open to freelance or full-time roles, full remote or relocation to Asia, Australia, Singapore
> and beyond. He builds with Symfony, Vue 3, TypeScript and Docker, and has working knowledge
> of Kubernetes (pods, kubectl, k9s). He holds an MSc in Cyber (development & security), top of
> his class, from Université catholique de Lille, and is currently on a work-study program at
> Alice's Garden (high-traffic e-commerce platform).

## Skills

- Backend: Symfony (services, custom bundles), API Platform (JWT/OAuth), serverless AWS Lambdas (Bref), Doctrine ORM (MariaDB/MySQL)
- Frontend: Vue 3 (Composition API, Pinia), React, TypeScript
- DevOps: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes basics (pods, kubectl, k9s)
- Testing & quality: PHPUnit, Behat, SOLID principles
- Areas of interest: cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning

## Site structure

The site is available in five languages. French is the default and has no URL prefix;
the other languages are served under a language prefix.

- [French (default)](https://sachadvr.fr/)
- [English](https://sachadvr.fr/en)
- [Spanish](https://sachadvr.fr/es)
- [Simplified Chinese](https://sachadvr.fr/zh)
- [Japanese](https://sachadvr.fr/ja)

Pages (replace `/` with `/en`, `/es`, `/zh` or `/ja` for other languages):

- `/` — home: profile, tech stack, featured projects, full portfolio, contact form
- `/links` — every social and contact link
- `/git/<repository-name>` — detail page for a public GitHub repository, rendering its README
- `/cgu` — terms of use (French version is the legally binding one)
- `/cgv` — terms of sale (French version is the legally binding one)

## Projects

Projects are pulled live from the public GitHub account https://github.com/sachadvr
and rendered on the home page and on `/git/<repository-name>` pages.
